message: 過去からの遺産

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Synn, if we don't hurry up we're gonna be late!」

name: Synn
message: 「We still have time, we'll be fine.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, I'm amazed you can wake up this early when you've been doing special training every single day.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you get used to it, it's no big deal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Acting all tough even with sore muscles--that's our Demon Lord for ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't need to say that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's kinda annoying for me since it cuts into my club time, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, at least you won't gain weight, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wasn't fat to begin with!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha.」
This sensation is...!

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord...?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Sorry, Nanaka. Looks like I forgot something, so go on ahead without me.」
This immense magical power, making my skin prickle even from a distance.
There's no mistake...!

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't mind waiting, though...?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. I'll catch right up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, hey, Synn!」
I can't recklessly drag my friends into this and put them in danger...

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff...」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous...」

name: Bylous
message: 「So you've become able to sense this level of presence.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Did you lure me here on purpose?」

name: Bylous
message: 「I was curious about the witch's handiwork.」

name: Bylous
message: 「However... just as I expected, you've turned out quite well.」

name: Bylous
message: 「From the way you carry yourself, I can clearly see the fruits of your training.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Still, I take it I've got a long way to go...」

name: Bylous
message: 「As long as you understand that, it's fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「As I am now, you could easily defeat me.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea, Synn Sakura.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I have no desire for a one-sided slaughter.」

name: Bylous
message: 「To hone my own strength and pit myself against proud, mighty warriors...」

name: Bylous
message: 「And in the midst of a battle pushed to the absolute limit, to feel proof that I am alive.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really all you're after...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I wish to know a sense of fulfillment that I have yet to experience.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Soltia, who tried to scheme against you, and this Re-Crea said to destroy the world--neither of them means anything to me.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Because right now, all I have eyes for is you.」
All I could feel was a fighting spirit so intense it made my throat go dry.
Does this man truly seek nothing more than a pure fight...?

name: Bylous
message: 「It was good meeting you today.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I look forward to the day we can cross blades.」
He's not an opponent I can beat with half-baked resolve.
Yet, from his entire demeanor, I couldn't sense a shred of malice.
Maybe calling him an enemy doesn't even fit.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Phew.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That covers just about all the records here...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To think I'd end up reading through past archives over and over like this...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I've been influenced by Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I still haven't found any more information than what we already have, so.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What's left is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The book we brought back from the land of Nive last time... I suppose.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I had hoped to avoid relying on the elders if possible, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「For Sakura-kun's sake...」

name: Melilot
message: 「When I think of it that way, I wouldn't mind at all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, let's give today's special training our all!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're really fired up~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, 'carrots and ignorance,' so I am sure she is being deceived.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or maybe she's just starting to feel good.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-That's not it at all!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone is just saying whatever they want...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Melilot-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「Have you all gathered, everyone!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, even Helena-san is here.」

name: Helena
message: 「What's that supposed to mean, am I not allowed to be here?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, that's not what I meant...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, I see. You want to be alone with Melilot that badly, huh? Well, that figures.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--! Hold on, hold on!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you saying, Helena!」

name: Helena
message: 「What am I saying? Just the truth?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn, what's she talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Who knows...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph... Your eyes are darting around! You definitely have a guilty conscience!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! Look, my eyes are as sharp as a hawk's!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't look at me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn... Are you keeping secrets from us, your comrades...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At this point, we have no choice but to torture it out of him!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I'll slice you wide open♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Gyaaaah!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone, please calm down a bit!」

name: Melilot
message: 「At this rate, we'll never be able to overcome Re-Crea!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... Sorry.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, if big sis Melilot says so, I guess I have no choice...」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Helena
message: 「You smoothed things over nicely!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena!」

name: Helena
message: 「Boo-hoo, something this harmless is just part of my charm~\s10」

name: Melilot
message: 「Honestly, you're just too slack, or rather...」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks to all this, I don't even have time to gush over my sweetheart~」

name: Melilot
message: 「I told you to stop!」

name: Helena
message: 「Aww, I'm just kidding around~\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your jokes are in poor taste! Good grief...」
Those two really get along well...
Well, maybe that's just because I heard about their past, though.
For the record, I'm not jealous... I think.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh... It makes me dread what lies ahead...」

name: Helena
message: 「You're taking things way too seriously, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm taking it seriously because it's a matter that demands it.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you worry too much, you'll just end up frozen in place, won't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「You've gotta loosen up a little.\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're always so optimistic...」

name: Helena
message: 「It'll be fine!」

name: Helena
message: 「At the very least, as far as we know, Re-Crea has never actually been fulfilled before.」

name: Melilot
message: 「True, this world is still intact even now, however...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then how do we even know that Re-Crea is gonna destroy the world?」

name: Misa
message: 「Now that you mention it... that's a good point.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's never destroyed anything once, isn't that weird?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hohoh, that's a sharp retort coming from our treasurer. My nose hairs are practically popping out of my eyes.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what's that supposed to mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I just mean it's a good question!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. It's completely natural for all of you to have doubts.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, an established theory has already been derived on that subject from past records and research...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Before getting into that, I should probably explain something else first.」

name: Melilot
message: 「About the origins of Finis Tower, which is the very reason Nive's mission came to be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Finis Tower...?」
Given what Melilot-san had told us, I'd always assumed it was an observation facility built by the people of Nive, but...

name: Melilot
message: 「According to the oldest records I've gotten my hands on...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is said that the one who built Finis Tower was the god who created the Three Realms.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, a god?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「To be precise, the story goes that the god had humans do the labor.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And at that time, what the god told the humans--namely, the ancestors of the Kujou family...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Was about the existence of a great power that regenerates the world, known as Re-Crea.」

name: Helena
message: 「And then, the Nive Clan inherited those records, is that it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「From what has been passed down to me, that is indeed the case.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm... So a god taught them about it, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still... it's strange, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why didn't the god build the tower themselves?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san, do you know anything about this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nope, not a clue.」

name: Melilot
message: 「How about considering that it wasn't that they didn't build it, but rather that they couldn't?」

name: Helena
message: 「Meaning they can't directly interfere with this world, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though I don't have concrete evidence to say that for certain.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though they went out of their way to have the tower built to protect the world...」

name: Synn
message: 「To then try and destroy it themselves...」

name: Synn
message: 「I really don't understand gods...」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is a way to interpret that as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Records regarding Re-Crea only exist from after the tower was built.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And before the Three Realms-or at least, the Human World-were formed, the world had a different shape...」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to the lore recording the encounter with the god, the world was originally one.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And then the god divided that world into its current form, and built the tower in the Human World, which serves as the boundary.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because it was only after that that Re-Crea began to be observed...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea is thought to be a force of providence by which the world attempts to return to its original form.」

name: Ria
message: 「So it's kind of like an unavoidable consequence of splitting the world......」

name: Synn
message: 「Then Re-Crea is a sort of natural phenomenon, and......」

name: Synn
message: 「The God who created our world is trying to save it...... is that it.」

name: Helena
message: 「And that's why they bestowed knowledge and countermeasures upon us.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though that is merely one way of looking at it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, in the end, as we are now, we can't verify God's existence anyway.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Even I don't know what they look like.」

name: Helena
message: 「As things stand, this is the interpretation that makes the most sense, right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, regardless of the truth, we cannot ignore the records and leave Re-Crea unchecked.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The observed energy of Re-Crea is convincing enough if one were told it could regenerate the world.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That alone is more than enough to call it a threat.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the Demon Lord is the one who stops it......」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a huge responsibility, isn't it......」
A talk meant to put me at ease somehow ended up making me acutely aware of the pressure.......

name: Melilot
message: 「Furthermore, there is a possibility that things will not go so straightforwardly this time.」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is strictly a prediction derived from past observational data, however......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea was understood to manifest starting from a periodically occurring peak of energy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yet, records have been found indicating that this energy can acquire some sort of vessel.」

name: Synn
message: 「A vessel......?」

name: Helena
message: 「A person or an object...... basically, a container of sorts for a great power to inhabit.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In other words, a being who houses the power of Re-Crea within themselves......」

name: Melilot
message: 「It means there may be someone operating in the shadows who could be called an agent of Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...!」

name: Synn
message: 「To think one person holds enough power to destroy the world...」
Could Bylous and I not even come close to matching that...?

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course, there has never been a case where Re-Crea was brought to fruition by the will of humans, angels, or demons.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, just once in the past...」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is a record stating that the power of Re-Crea possessed a human as its vessel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Re-Crea, inside a human...!」

name: Synn
message: 「What... happened back then?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Nothing happened at all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A fragile human body had no hope of withstanding Re-Crea's energy, small-scale though it was...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is recorded that Re-Crea vanished and dissipated along with that human.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That phenomenon was likely nothing more than a product of chance.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, as long as there has been even one such precedent, we cannot say for certain there won't be a second.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And suppose a vessel capable of withstanding Re-Crea's energy were to appear...」

name: Synn
message: 「A proxy of Re-Crea would stop being just a hypothesis...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If Re-Crea's power were to be controlled by a proxy's will...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even we would have a considerably difficult time dealing with it.」

name: Misa
message: 「But it's not set in stone that it'll turn out like that yet, right...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately... wishful thinking will serve no purpose.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is because the past possession by Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The observation records from that time and those of the current Re-Crea bear an extreme resemblance.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If I were to point out a difference, it would be the scale of its power...」

name: Ria
message: 「Meaning, naturally, that it's larger this time around...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if it fails to obtain a vessel, it's not small enough to simply dissipate...」

name: Melilot
message: 「And if it does obtain a vessel, it will trigger a worst-case scenario...」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no doubt we can definitively call this Re-Crea an anomaly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that agent is Soltia...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, the probability of that is low.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I considered that possibility at first, too, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that were the case, there is no way they would resort to such a roundabout method.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's true...」

name: Helena
message: 「It just means you need to keep in mind the possibility that a dangerous mastermind like that is lurking behind the scenes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We ought to prepare for the worst-case scenario.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right...」

name: Synn
message: 「Things might certainly be getting more serious this time than ever before.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we're the only ones who can drive back Re-Crea and save the world right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「That makes it more than worth the effort, doesn't it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, that is exactly right.」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that's the spirit! You're starting to look like a man we can really count on.」

name: Macaron
message: 「All right! Then special training really is the only way to go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, I won't lose today!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bring it on, I won't either!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will be pushing you just as hard today, so everyone please prepare yourselves accordingly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, give it everything you've got!」
Plus, Helena, Shio, and Riesling have been joining in on our special training since the other day...
Helena joined the party!
Shio-chan joined the party!
Riesling-san joined the party!
Both our strength and morale are on a whole different level now.
Besides, whether someone's will is behind it or it's just a natural phenomenon, that's no big deal.
If we don't give it our all, everyone's happiness might be shattered and lost.
What matters is protecting the world with our own hands.
Because we have to protect our future.

name: Melilot
message: 「Good work on your training today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You seemed a bit stiff out there today, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... I guess I let it get into my head.」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, I ran into Bylous this morning...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Is that so?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Did he say anything to you?」

name: Synn
message: 「That he's looking forward to when we cross blades.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. That certainly sounds like him.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, after actually talking with him, I realized something.」

name: Synn
message: 「He isn't challenging us out of malice.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it might end up accelerating Re-Crea as a result...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not his true goal.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Perhaps so.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, that doesn't change the fact that he is an opponent we must defeat, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know that.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just, if we're going to fight anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to make it a proper match.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that is how you feel, Sakura-kun, then I suppose that is fine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, if you do anything too reckless, I will stop you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't do anything like leaving your side, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That goes without saying!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, I know.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that's the case, then I don't mind, but...」
The hand enveloping mine tightens with a gentle squeeze.
I squeeze it firmly back.
Even without words between us...
Our hearts were firmly connected.
